name: @framepilot/desktop
description: FramePilot Electron desktop shell. Renderer is provided by @framepilot/web-editor.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @framepilot/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @framepilot/timeline-schema build && pnpm --filter @framepilot/editor-core build && pnpm --filter @framepilot/ai-sdk build && pnpm build:main && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names vite,electron --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @framepilot/web-editor dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:engine && electron-builder
scripts.dist:unpacked: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:engine && electron-builder --dir
